# Atlas launch decision

2025-03-14: The Atlas data migration launch moved from April 3 to April 17 after failed reconciliation checks. Priya Rao owns the migration; Omar Bell owns rollback. Rollback is triggered if missing invoice rows exceed 0.5 percent. RFC-2041 records the decision. The project is unrelated to Atlas travel insurance.

# Atlas travel insurance

The Atlas travel insurance policy TRV-2041 covers canceled flights after a twelve-hour delay. The claim deductible is $150. Maya Chen is the broker. This policy does not cover data migration services or business interruption.

# Archived retention standard

Effective 2023-01-01: production audit logs were retained for 30 days. Backups were retained for 14 days. This standard was superseded by the 2025 retention policy on 2025-02-01. Do not apply these durations to current operations.

# Current retention policy

Effective 2025-02-01: production audit logs must be retained for 90 days and encrypted backups for 35 days. This supersedes the 2023 standard of 30-day logs and 14-day backups. Legal holds suspend automatic deletion. The security team approves any retention exception.

# Harbor vendor rate card

Service | Monthly price | Included requests
Basic | $120 | 10000
Growth | $340 | 50000
Enterprise | $980 | 200000

Overage costs $8 per thousand requests for Basic and Growth. Enterprise overage is negotiated. These prices exclude sales tax and do not apply to employee benefits.

# Harbor employee benefits

Harbor employees receive a $340 annual wellness allowance and twelve paid volunteer hours per year. The benefits administrator is Leah Finch. Reimbursement requires an itemized receipt within 45 days. Vendor subscription rates have no relationship to this allowance.

# Incident INC-782

2025-05-06: Checkout failures started at 09:12 UTC and ended at 09:41 UTC. A stale certificate bundle broke the payment connection. Rotating database credentials did not help; replacing the certificate bundle restored service. Owner: Devon Pike. Action: alert 21 days before certificate expiry.

# Incident INC-728

2024-11-18: Checkout requests timed out because the payment database connection pool was exhausted. Increasing the pool to 120 connections restored service. Owner: Elise Hart. No certificate changes were needed. Follow-up: cap background settlement concurrency at eight workers.

# Purchase order PO-008142

PO-008142 orders 24 docking stations from Northwind Hardware at $85 each. Delivery is due 2025-06-10 at the east warehouse. Approver: Serena Vale. Invoice INV-008142 is separate and covers consulting; do not confuse the shared digits.

# Invoice INV-008142

INV-008142 covers 18 consulting hours from Northwind Advisory at $160 per hour. Payment terms are net 45 days. The billing contact is Tomas Reed. This invoice does not purchase docking stations or other hardware.

# Backup restoration runbook

Restore into an isolated staging database first. Verify row counts and reconciliation checksums before switching traffic. Recovery point objective is fifteen minutes; recovery time objective is two hours. The on-call SRE approves traffic cutover. Never restore directly over the active production database.

# Employee travel policy

Economy flights are reimbursed without special approval. Business class requires CFO approval for flights longer than eight hours. Lodging reimbursement is capped at $210 per night before tax. Submit receipts within 30 days after returning. The $150 travel-insurance deductible is not a lodging limit.

# Home garden plan

The raised beds contain tomatoes, basil, and carrots. Water early in the morning twice weekly, increasing to three times during heat waves. Soil test GDN-553 shows pH 6.4. Add compost in autumn; avoid nitrogen fertilizer near harvest. The garden is not part of the office wellness program.

# Borealis accessibility review

2025-07-22: Borealis ships a mobile document reader. The release is blocked by keyboard focus loss when closing the search dialog. Account recovery and color contrast passed review. Nia Cole owns the focus fix; acceptance requires returning focus to the search button. This is unrelated to the Atlas data migration.

# Laptop asset inventory

Asset | Assignee | RAM | Replacement quarter
LT-041 | Rowan Dale | 16 GB | Q3
LT-014 | Casey Moss | 32 GB | Q1
LT-104 | Quinn Lake | 64 GB | Q4

Only LT-014 is eligible for early replacement. Similar asset numbers represent different machines.

# Support response matrix

Severity | Initial response | Escalation
S1 total outage | 15 minutes | incident commander
S2 major impairment | 2 hours | support lead
S3 question | 1 business day | assigned agent

Response targets are acknowledgments, not guarantees of resolution. Weekend coverage applies to S1 only.

# Related reference

Atlas map collection contains nineteenth-century sea charts. The curator is Omar Bell; the restoration deadline is April 3. These are museum artifacts, unrelated to the Atlas migration.

# Related reference

Superseded Atlas launch draft: Priya Rao initially proposed April 3. This proposal is obsolete; see the Atlas launch decision for the approved date and rollback owner.

# Related reference

Growth marketing forecasts 50000 page views and an annual budget of $340000. This is advertising spend, not the Harbor subscription rate card.

# Related reference

The office garden has succulents and receives water once monthly. It is not the home raised-bed garden and has no soil test GDN-553.

# Related reference

Withdrawn support draft: S1 acknowledgement target was 30 minutes; S2 was 4 hours. The support response matrix supersedes this draft.

# Related reference

Incident INC-872 concerned a broken image thumbnail cache. It did not involve payments. Restarting the thumbnail worker fixed the issue.

# Related reference

Purchase requisition LT-140 covers laptop sleeves. Rowan Dale requested 24 sleeves. This is not the laptop asset inventory.

# Related reference

Northwind Hardware signed a nondisclosure agreement with Serena Vale. The confidentiality term is three years. It specifies no purchase quantities.

# Related reference

Northwind Advisory audit planning mentions Tomas Reed and a net 30 target for future contracts. Existing invoice terms remain unchanged.

# Related reference

Home insurance policy HME-2041 has a $1000 deductible and no coverage for flight delays. Maya Chen is also the broker.

# Related reference

Personal tablet backups run once weekly and are kept for six months. These are unrelated to production database backup objectives.

# Related reference

Borealis is the name of an office lighting installation. Nia Cole designed the search-button motif on the wall mural. The lights have no software release schedule.

# Related reference

Conference travel forecast assumes lodging at $250 per night. This planning estimate is not an approved reimbursement policy.

# Related reference

Sales lead retention is 180 days. This marketing rule excludes production audit logs and database backups.

# Related reference

Superseded wellness proposal suggested $120 annually. The employee benefits policy adopted a different allowance.

# Related reference

The internal wiki certificate expires in December. Its owner is Devon Pike. It is separate from the payment certificate involved in INC-782.
